name: my:Optima Secure follow-up dialogues v3 (final deciding set)
description: Conversations for the final evaluation of conversation memory, written and frozen before any run with them, after the second run. Each later turn's complete form is the test-set question named in 'item' (test split, answered correctly in the published baseline). Follow-ups are written as people ask them, including some that refer back without a pointing word. follow_up / after_refusal: the follow-up leaves out its subject (checked when loaded); self_contained: it names it; topic_switch: a new question asked exactly as in the test set.
